text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since Victoire Pisa got injured, I brought 
her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for making you worry... But I'm 
all right now.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Now that the treatment is finished, let us 
return to training right away.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I cannot afford to disrupt the 
training regimen that Trainer has put 
together for me.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
However, it seems they went through quite 
a struggle to settle on this menu...
choice_data_list: そんなのいくらでも組み直すよ！
choice_data_list_en: I can redo that schedule as many times as you need!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fortunately, the injury was only minor, 
and I wouldn't want to trouble you any 
further, Trainer.
choice_data_list:
...I just want you to not push yourself 
too hard.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fortunately, the injury was only minor, 
and I wouldn't want to trouble you any 
further, Trainer.
choice_data_list: ……無理だけはしないでほしい
choice_data_list_en: ...I just don't want you to push yourself too hard.
...Just don't push yourself too hard, okay?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Still, if we do that, Trainer will...!
choice_data_list: ……無理だけはしないでほしい
choice_data_list_en: ...I just don't want you to push yourself too hard.
...Just don't push yourself too hard, okay?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: 不測の事態に対応するのも仕事だから
choice_data_list_en: Handling unexpected situations is part of the job, after all.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... That was presumptuous of me. 
When no one cares more deeply about the 
Umamusume than you do...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Understood. I will make sure to get plenty 
of rest now so that I don't fall behind 
any further.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, after making her promise to tell 
me immediately if it hurt, we returned to 
training, but—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Um, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, if I move any more than this, 
I'll probably...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Yes... I am truly sorry.
choice_data_list: ！すぐ保健室に連れていくよ！
choice_data_list_en: ! I'll take you to the infirmary right away!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because Victoire Pisa's injury worsened, I 
decided to have her take a break and rest 
for a while.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, after making her promise to tell 
me immediately if it hurt, we returned to 
training—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, yeah. Looks like she's okay. 
Thank goodness it wasn't a serious injury.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I can't cause any more trouble for 
Trainer. Carefully, very carefully..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Not pushing too hard paid off, and she 
successfully overcame her injury.
